rows.contract: Build and link the final native Qt target against actual SDK targets AppKit, QuartzCore, Metal and MetalFX without prohibited Vulkan dependencies.
rows.native_mapping: Configure native and feature-off Qt modes, run actual native link, inspect arm64 symbol listings, and run shared PICA and CTest.
rows.expected_result: One ObjC++ ARC bridge definition and actual target linkage; baseline regressions pass.
rows.actual_result: Actual native/off Qt graph, one native ARC bridge and single linked symbol, Qt core renderer-independent dependency closure, native app link, offscreen target rejection, PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Exercise native AppKit/Qt linkage with actual desktop runtime, having compiled only the owned bridge.
rows.native_mapping: Repeat Phase 081 ownership tests with the revised CMake graph; verify present to matched hardware when 091 is available.
rows.expected_result: Offscreen rejection and actual linked bridge host pass; visible Cocoa window and Metal4 rendering driven with real hardware later.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Actual native and Software-only Qt app links must resolve their intended framework closure in separate CMake builds.
rows.native_mapping: Link QuartzCore directly to the existing Apple feature-off Qt path. Keep the native bridge private and ARC-managed, and preserve the software renderer and shared window helper.
rows.expected_result: Both arm64 Qt executables link. Software-only has QuartzCore with no Metal, MetalFX, Vulkan or MoltenVK direct link. Native still has one ARC bridge and all required native frameworks. PICA/CTest pass in both configurations.
rows.actual_result: Software-only link failed with unresolved _OBJC_CLASS_$_CAMetalLayer. Production correction is pending.
